title: Lyubomira 'Val' Buresch on the page-25 passage Eric read at STATION DC
summary: Lyubomira Buresch — author, leader, facilitator — says the passage Eric read on page 25 stayed with her after the STATION DC fireside.
blockquote:
Last night at Station DC, I heard Eric Ries and Ari Shapiro discuss Eric's new book Incorruptible.

The passage that Eric read on page 25 stayed with me.
